guide_extractions.document_match_reason: The guide identifies the upcoming game as BYU at TCU on October 3, 2026, at Amon G. Carter Stadium and includes TCU-specific opponent information, statistics and series notes.

recent_game.fact: BYU defeated Colorado State 41-23 in Fort Collins to improve to 3-0.
BYU rushed for 332 yards against Colorado State and scored 31 consecutive points after the game opened 7-7.
LJ Martin rushed for 176 yards and three touchdowns on 15 carries against Colorado State.
Freshman wide receiver Legend Glasker caught five passes for 131 yards and added a rushing touchdown against Colorado State.
Freshman running back Journee Tonga rushed 10 times for 91 yards against Colorado State.
BYU's defense held Colorado State to 302 total yards and recorded an interception by Hunter Clegg.

opponent_notes.fact: TCU enters the matchup 2-2 overall and 0-1 in the Big 12 after a 21-13 road loss to UCF.
TCU is averaging 303.3 passing yards per game, ranking No. 17 nationally and No. 3 in the Big 12.
TCU is averaging 138.8 rushing yards per game, ranking No. 100 nationally and No. 15 in the Big 12.
TCU's defense allows 12.5 points and 264.8 total yards per game, ranking No. 14 and No. 21 nationally, respectively.
TCU leads the Big 12 in third-down defense, allowing conversions on 24.5 percent of attempts.
TCU allows 86.0 rushing yards per game and 178.8 passing yards per game.
TCU has recovered four fumbles, tied for the Big 12 lead, but has lost seven total turnovers and owns a minus-0.25 turnover margin per game.
TCU has allowed nine sacks for 53 yards through four games.

quarterback.fact: Bear Bachmeier has started all three games and completed 44 of 62 passes for 642 yards, six touchdowns and one interception while rushing for 64 yards and two touchdowns.
Bachmeier leads the Big 12 in passing efficiency at 186.7 and in yards per pass attempt at 10.35.
Bachmeier completed 71.0 percent of his passes through BYU's first three games.
Bachmeier was the 2025 Big 12 Offensive Freshman of the Year and set BYU's quarterback record with 11 rushing touchdowns in 2025.
Treyson Bourguet, a Western Michigan transfer with eight previous career starts, is listed as Bachmeier's primary backup.

offensive_personnel.fact: LJ Martin has 328 rushing yards and three touchdowns on 42 carries through three games, averaging 7.8 yards per carry.
Legend Glasker has 270 receiving yards and two receiving touchdowns on 11 catches, plus 42 rushing yards and two rushing touchdowns.
Glasker became the first wide receiver in Big 12 history with multiple rushing and receiving touchdowns through his team's first three games of a season.
Oregon transfer Kyler Kasper has nine catches for 116 yards and two touchdowns and has recorded a reception in each of BYU's first three games.
USC transfer Walker Lyons has started all three games at tight end and caught multiple passes in each game.
Oregon transfer Roger Saleapaga started the first two games at tight end, while Keayen Nead started against Colorado State.
Freshmen Devaughn Eka and Journee Tonga have both scored rushing touchdowns this season.
BYU's listed offensive line starters are Paki Finau at left tackle, Sonny Makasini at left guard, Bruce Mitchell at center, Kyle Sfarcioc at right guard and Andrew Gentry at right tackle.
Trevin Ostler replaced Kyle Sfarcioc in the starting lineup at right guard against Colorado State.
BYU has allowed two sacks through three games and ranks No. 1 nationally with only one tackle for loss allowed per game.

defensive_personnel.fact: Cal transfer Cade Uluave has started all three games at linebacker and has 14 tackles, two tackles for loss and one interception.
Tausili Akana has started all three games and has 2.5 sacks, four tackles for loss and one fumble recovery.
Cannon DeVries has started the past two games at nickel and recorded three tackles for loss against Colorado State.
Isaiah Glasker started against Arizona and Colorado State after not appearing in the opener and has 13 tackles through two games.
Keanu Tanuvasa has started all three games at defensive tackle and has 1.5 tackles for loss and half a sack.
Faletau Satuala has started all three games at free safety after leading BYU with 84 tackles in 2025.
Tommy Prassas started the past two games at strong safety after Raider Damuni was injured in the opener.

injury_availability.fact: Safety Raider Damuni was injured against Utah Tech and has appeared in only one game this season.
Linebacker Siale Esera was listed as out for BYU's most recent game against Colorado State; the guide does not state his status for TCU.

offensive_context.fact: BYU averages 481.7 total yards and 44.0 points per game.
BYU ranks No. 9 nationally with 262.7 rushing yards per game and has exceeded 300 rushing yards twice in three games.
BYU has scored at least five rushing touchdowns in two games this season.
BYU converts 61.3 percent of its third downs, ranking No. 3 nationally.
BYU has produced at least 500 yards of total offense in two of its first three games after doing so twice during the entire 2025 season.

defensive_context.fact: BYU allows 15.7 points, 271.0 total yards and 76.0 rushing yards per game.
BYU has intercepted five passes and forced six total turnovers through three games.
BYU has won 17 consecutive games when forcing at least one turnover, tied with Indiana for the longest active FBS streak.
BYU's defense allows opponents to convert 43.6 percent of third downs, ranking last in the Big 12.
BYU has recorded four sacks through three games.

special_teams.fact: Cannon DeVries returned a kickoff 100 yards for a touchdown against Utah Tech and leads the Big 12 with 200 combined kickoff-return yards.
Starting punter Fuller Shurtz averages 48.1 yards on seven punts, with four punts traveling at least 50 yards.
BYU ranks No. 3 nationally and first in the Big 12 with a 47.43-yard net punting average.
Matthias Dunn is 2-for-3 on field goals and 15-for-15 on extra points, including two made field goals against Colorado State.
Freshman Brody Laga is BYU's primary kickoff specialist and has produced touchbacks on 22 of 23 kickoffs.
TCU has blocked two kicks and one punt while allowing no blocked kicks or punts.

series_context.fact: This is the 14th meeting between BYU and TCU, with TCU leading the series 7-6.
BYU defeated TCU 44-13 in 2025, snapping a five-game losing streak in the series and recording its largest victory margin over the Horned Frogs.
BYU held TCU to a season-low 13 points in the 2025 meeting.
BYU is 6-0 against TCU when allowing fewer than 30 points and 0-7 when allowing at least 30.

other_relevant.fact: BYU enters the road matchup 3-0 overall and 1-0 in Big 12 play, while TCU is 2-2 overall and 0-1 in conference play.
The game is scheduled for October 3, 2026, at Amon G. Carter Stadium in Fort Worth.
